overview.text: Today's artificial intelligence landscape features major infrastructure releases, agentic research benchmarks, and domain-specific models. Mistral AI introduced Voxtral 3, a voice agent SDK supporting real-time speech across multiple languages with emotional text-to-speech, alongside Timestral, a probabilistic forecasting model. Meanwhile, the open community and researchers gained access to DeepInfer, a high-performance inference framework designed for DeepSeek models, offering valuable architectural insights for custom engines. Anthropic demonstrated biological application capabilities by detailing how an internal research model designed protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins. OpenAI advanced software engineering capabilities by improving ChatGPT for low-resource programming languages and COBOL migration. In research, new evaluations like OR-License and OpenVLHarness test LLM agents on real-world operations research and visual tool-use tasks. Finally, model releases such as Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, Lightricks/LTX-2.5, and facebook/sam3 expand multimodal capabilities across text, video, and mask generation.

entries.title: DeepInfer: High-performance inference framework for DeepSeek models
entries.summary: This is crazy good for studying to improve existing custom engines by community like gufo, halogen, strixite, Strata... by learning their secret sauces.
entries.why: Provides high-performance inference techniques for DeepSeek models to improve custom execution engines.

entries.title: Voxtral 3
entries.summary: Voxtral 3: Mistral's voice agent SDK for real-time speech in 50+ languages — accurate transcription, emotional TTS, deep tool use. EU-hosted or self-deployed.
entries.why: Offers a voice agent SDK with real-time multilingual speech, emotional text-to-speech, and deep tool use.

entries.title: How Claude designed protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins
entries.summary: We asked an internal research Claude model to design minibinders (small proteins that attach tightly to a target) against scorpion neurotoxins.
entries.why: Demonstrates practical protein binder design against scorpion neurotoxins using internal research models.

entries.title: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages
entries.summary: Learn how OpenAI is improving ChatGPT across low-resource programming languages, with new evaluations for software engineering, SQLite, and COBOL migration.
entries.why: Improves software engineering capabilities and evaluation in low-resource programming languages and COBOL.

entries.title: OR-License: Evaluating LLM Agents as Real-World Operations Research Practitioners
entries.summary: Can large language model (LLM) agents deliver expert-level operations research (OR) solutions directly from original client materials, without prior expert reformulation?
entries.why: Evaluates LLM agents as real-world operations research practitioners using original client materials.

entries.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
entries.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the…
entries.why: Examines real-world visual agentic tool-use with multimodal memory across multiple benchmarks.

entries.title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
entries.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown promising potential in coding tasks, and their performance is jointly determined by the policy model and the harness that mediates their interaction with the environment.
entries.why: Explores self-evolving coding agents through joint optimization of policy models and environment harnesses.

entries.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
entries.why: Delivers a new image-text-to-text transformer model for multimodal machine learning tasks.

entries.title: Lightricks/LTX-2.5
entries.why: Provides a diffusion-based single-file image-to-video generation model for visual creators.

entries.title: facebook/sam3
entries.why: Brings a mask-generation transformer model to the computer vision and segmentation ecosystem.

entries.title: Introducing Timestral
entries.summary: State-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting in four sizes (5M–209M params), CPU-efficient, zero-shot ready.
entries.why: Delivers state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting in multiple sizes with CPU-efficient zero-shot readiness.

entries.title: Circuits updates july 2024
entries.why: Provides structural circuit updates relevant to mechanistic interpretability and model safety research.

entries.title: Latest open artifacts (#25): DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, American-made models, and new regulatory controls in the US & China
entries.why: Analyzes recent open artifacts including DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 and evolving regulatory controls.

entries.title: Battle Drones - a vibe coded RTS with audio-based multiplayer
entries.summary: My latest vibe coded game experiment is a Command & Conquer style RTS (Real Time Strategy) game called Battle Drones (play it here). Unlike my previous experiments, this one is actually fun to play.
entries.why: Showcases a vibe-coded real-time strategy game experiment featuring audio-based multiplayer mechanics.

entries.title: How To Use Decision Models for Evals
entries.summary: Decision models have exploded onto the scene recently, starting with TypeSafe’s Jev, followed by Perplexity’s Decider, Liquid’s d1, Cloudflare’s Clef, and OpenAI’s Decisions API1. These models promise fast, inexpensive classification.
entries.why: Explores the application of fast decision models for inexpensive classification and evaluation tasks.
